name: Frigate
description: A complete and local NVR designed for Home Assistant with AI object detection.  Uses OpenCV and Tensorflow to perform realtime object detection locally for IP cameras.
author: Blake Blackshear

form_fields.label: Frigate RTSP password
form_fields.hint: Password used for RTSP camera stream authentication (FRIGATE_RTSP_PASSWORD). Web UI admin password is generated in the container console/logs on first startup.
